exposure: immediate postpartum insertion of TCu380A intrauterine device
presence of medical or social problems
cohort: 511 women in Tanzania who had a TCu380A intrauterine device inserted within 48 hours of delivery
finding: The one-year continuation rate of the TCu380A intrauterine device when used for immediate postpartum contraception is high, with low complication and failure rates.
mod_finding: Delivery by caesarean section was an independent risk factor for IUD continuation at one year.
